coordinator_recovery_scenarios.behavior: Pending uncommitted journal transactions are discarded; no partial manifest published.

coordinator_recovery_scenarios.scenario: Coordinator crash immediately after commit journal write
coordinator_recovery_scenarios.behavior: Cold restart replays commit journal record; manifest is recovered and accessible.

coordinator_recovery_scenarios.scenario: Torn write / partial sector write at tail of WAL
coordinator_recovery_scenarios.behavior: Checksum mismatch detects corrupted tail record; WAL is safely truncated to last valid transaction.

coordinator_recovery_scenarios.scenario: Snapshot checkpoint restoration followed by incremental WAL replay
coordinator_recovery_scenarios.behavior: Coordinator state restores to exact snapshot point then advances through WAL delta.
